# 0006. Recognize the inherited Kaggle image marker
Supersedes [0005](0005-qualify-kaggle-evaluation-separately.md) only for its operational mixed-marker assumption; all other constraints remain in force.

The actual Kaggle Interactive runtime has `/kaggle/working` and `KAGGLE_KERNEL_RUN_TYPE=Interactive`, together with `COLAB_RELEASE_TAG=release-colab-external-images_20260917-060051_RC00`. A T4 is now live, with reported Python 3.13.15 and Torch 2.11/CUDA 12.8. The inherited Colab image tag caused the initial evaluation admission check to reject this genuine Kaggle runtime. Full dependency, font, model and matched evaluation qualification remain pending.

Explicit Kaggle evaluation may retain a Colab image tag only when all existing Kaggle checks pass: explicit provider selection, remote-development opt-in, Linux, an allowlisted Interactive/Batch kernel marker and `/kaggle/working` directory. Record the image tag verbatim as `inherited_colab_release_tag` in provider provenance when present; never delete or spoof environment markers. Colab evaluation continues to reject Kaggle context. The training guard, frozen inference/data/settings and exact package gates remain unchanged.
+ Genuine Kaggle image inheritance no longer prevents bounded evaluation admission, and its provenance remains inspectable.

- Environment markers alone still do not qualify hardware, packages, model quality or execution authority. Unknown or incomplete Kaggle context remains rejected before ML imports; independent source gates and actual runtime qualification remain required.
Status: source implemented, CPU-tested and independently reviewed; actual provider qualification pending. Review: full. Depends on H21a/b/c/d source and retained pilot identity.

Status: initial source independently reviewed; inherited-image compatibility repair CPU-tested, independent repair gates pending. Actual full runtime/model qualification pending. Review: full. Depends on H21a/b/c/d source and retained pilot identity.

Retain the original remote_guard's Colab-only behavior for training callers. Add a distinct evaluation-only admission seam. Default evaluation remains Colab; Kaggle requires an explicit provider opt-in plus existing HALA_REMOTE_DEVELOPMENT_ALLOWED=1, Linux, a genuine known Kaggle kernel marker and /kaggle/working directory, and absence of conflicting Colab marker. Reject unknown providers, ambiguous/missing markers, unsupported platform/mode and lack of opt-in before ML imports/allocation. No generic Linux bypass or spoofed Colab marker. Record the admitted evaluation provider honestly in result metadata. Keep adapter external-identity validation before ML and no baseline fallback.

Retain the original remote_guard's Colab-only behavior for training callers. Add a distinct evaluation-only admission seam. Default evaluation remains Colab; Kaggle requires an explicit provider opt-in plus existing HALA_REMOTE_DEVELOPMENT_ALLOWED=1, Linux, a genuine known Kaggle kernel marker and /kaggle/working directory. A Colab image tag inherited within that complete Kaggle context is retained and recorded under ADR0006. Reject unknown providers, missing Kaggle context, unsupported platform/mode and lack of opt-in before ML imports/allocation. Colab evaluation still rejects Kaggle context. No generic Linux bypass or spoofed Colab marker. Record the admitted evaluation provider honestly in result metadata. Keep adapter external-identity validation before ML and no baseline fallback.

Known Kaggle run types Interactive/Batch may be implemented as a strict allowlist, but actual Kaggle UI/runtime environment evidence must confirm the deployed marker before GPU execution. This is an explicit operational qualification spike, not proof from tests. Actual account verification/GPU availability remains unresolved in the UI; source work must not infer eligibility. No provisioning/billing/account creation, phone/OTP handling, secrets, telemetry or public service.

Known Kaggle run types Interactive/Batch use a strict allowlist. The actual Interactive runtime now has a live T4, `/kaggle/working`, and the inherited `COLAB_RELEASE_TAG=release-colab-external-images_20260917-060051_RC00`; Python 3.13.15 and Torch 2.11/CUDA 12.8 were reported from that runtime. These observations replace the earlier unresolved phone-verification/GPU UI state. Full dependency/font/model qualification and matched inference remain pending; CPU tests do not establish them. No provisioning/billing/account creation, phone/OTP handling, secrets, telemetry or public service.

`evaluation.development_runtime.run(..., provider='colab')` and CLI `--provider colab` retain the default. Kaggle requires `provider='kaggle'` or `--provider kaggle`; an environment marker alone cannot opt in. `evaluation_guard` admits only Linux, `HALA_REMOTE_DEVELOPMENT_ALLOWED=1`, `KAGGLE_KERNEL_RUN_TYPE` exactly `Interactive` or `Batch`, an existing `/kaggle/working` directory, and no `COLAB_RELEASE_TAG` key. Colab evaluation rejects any Kaggle marker key, including an empty value. The original `remote_guard` remains unchanged for training callers. No cache policy, package pin or inference setting was relaxed.

`evaluation.development_runtime.run(..., provider='colab')` and CLI `--provider colab` retain the default. Kaggle requires `provider='kaggle'` or `--provider kaggle`; an environment marker alone cannot opt in. `evaluation_guard` admits only Linux, `HALA_REMOTE_DEVELOPMENT_ALLOWED=1`, `KAGGLE_KERNEL_RUN_TYPE` exactly `Interactive` or `Batch`, and an existing `/kaggle/working` directory. An inherited `COLAB_RELEASE_TAG`, if present, is recorded verbatim as `inherited_colab_release_tag`. Colab evaluation rejects any Kaggle marker key, including an empty value. The original `remote_guard` remains unchanged for training callers. No cache policy, package pin or inference setting was relaxed.

The inherited-image regression first reproduced the real rejection, then passed after removing only the Colab-tag exclusion from the strict Kaggle branch and preserving that tag in provenance. Missing/unknown Kaggle context, wrong OS/path and missing opt-in still reject before ML imports; Colab evaluation and training still reject the actual mixed context. The scoped runtime/provider/adapter suite passes 23 tests, including saved baseline/candidate inherited-image provenance.

Repair full CPU gate: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -q` ran 221 tests in 28.730 seconds, passed with one skip. AST comparison against the prior reviewed runtime preserves complete `SETTINGS`, `QwenInfer`, `remote_guard` and `VERSIONS`; independent repair gates remain pending.

Full CPU gate on Windows with bundled Python: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -q` ran 220 tests in 24.827 seconds, passed with one skip. `git diff --check` passed. These results do not satisfy the separate independent review or operational qualification gates.
